stem: Candice needs a more effective thesis statement for her paper. Which sentence should replace sentence 8 to serve as the thesis statement?

options.label: F
options.text: There are other barrier reefs in the oceans of the world, but only the Great Barrier Reef is so well known.

options.label: G
options.text: The Great Barrier Reef of Australia is a supreme example of the mysteries of the natural world because of its wide variety of plant and animal life.

options.label: H
options.text: Some scientists believe the Great Barrier Reef first began to grow about 18 million years ago.

options.label: J
options.text: A coral reef like the Great Barrier Reef can grow only in shallow, warm water because it needs light from the sun to survive.
